messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads up — noticed our customer health score distribution shifted for mid-market accounts this week. A bunch of accounts dropped from green -> yellow with no recent activity. Suspect onboarding touchpoints not firing.
Rory Patel: Interesting — did you filter by cohort? could be a segmentation bug.
Aisha Khan: Filtered by cohort + signup month. The drop aligns with onboarding playbook changes we shipped last Thursday.
Sam Ortega: Which playbook change? I merged the PR that tweaked the "first-success-call" trigger to include product_event = "tour_completed"
Nina (CS Ops): That was the change I asked for — product team wanted faster progression. But we didn't update the healthscore mapping, so "tour_completed" might be de-prioritized for early NPS signals.
Aisha Khan: Right — healthscore rule expects either "first_success_call" or "first_login_7d". Adding "tour_completed" meant a lot of accounts skipped the original trigger.
Rory Patel: Ok — quick plan: 1) Temporarily backfill the playbook to re-emit the original trigger where missing, 2) update scoring to weight "tour_completed" appropriately, 3) add a guardrail test to the playbook CI.
Sam Ortega: I can push a backfill job. SQL to find affected accounts:
```
SELECT account_id
FROM onboarding_events
WHERE signup_month = '2026-02'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM health_triggers ht
    WHERE ht.account_id = onboarding_events.account_id
      AND ht.trigger_type IN ('first_success_call','first_login_7d')
  )
  AND event_type = 'tour_completed';
```
I can run this on staging and then prod with a low QPS.
Nina (CS Ops): If you backfill, can we also attach a temporary note on the account explaining the backfill action so CSMs aren't surprised?
Aisha Khan: Yes — playbook-bot, create note template for backfill entries and tag CSM queue.
playbook-bot: Created note template at /playbooks/cs/backfill-notes. Tagged queue #csm-ops.
Rory Patel: For scoring changes, let's avoid a global weight change. Propose creating a modelled rule: add +5 score for tour_completed when it co-occurs with first_login_7d, else +1. We can A/B test on 10% of accounts.
Sam Ortega: I'll open a PR for the scoring config update and the CI test. Tagging @Nina for acceptance criteria: what defines acceptable regression?
Nina (CS Ops): Acceptance: no more than 2% net decrease in accounts classified as "on-track" per cohort; run retrospective eval over last 90 days. Also require playbook logs to emit both old and new triggers for 7 days in staging.
Aisha Khan: Timeline? We should aim for backfill & note template today, scoring PR tomorrow, and A/B rollout early next week.
Rory Patel: Agreed. Sam — assign the backfill run a throttle and add a retry window. Also include an idempotency key so we don't duplicate trigger events.
Sam Ortega: Will do. Backfill job will use idempotency = concat(account_id,'-onboard-backfill-202603') and rate-limit 20/s.
Nina (CS Ops): I'll prep a CSM slack broadcast and a short FAQ for the tagged accounts.
Aisha Khan: Thanks all. After the backfill, I'll pull a diff of healthscore counts and post here.
Sam Ortega: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/playbooks/pulls/231 — includes SQL, backfill runner, and CI test.
Rory Patel: I'll review the PR in the next hour.
Aisha Khan: Posting expected metrics snapshot after backfill: total affected accounts ~182, predicted recoveries ~165. If things look off we'll rollback scoring change.
Nina (CS Ops): Thanks — ETA for CSM broadcast is 3pm PT.
playbook-bot: Deploy job queued: backfill-runner v1.3 -> staging.
Sam Ortega: Backfill started on staging (run id bf-202603-01). Logs: `processed 182 accounts, created 165 trigger events, 17 skipped (already had triggers)`.
Aisha Khan: Great — can you run the healthscore diff next and paste counts?
Sam Ortega: Healthscore counts (staging) pre/backfill/after: {"green": 1240 -> 1238 -> 1390, "yellow": 310 -> 495 -> 265, "red": 45 -> 49 -> 42}
Rory Patel: Those shifts look sensible — green up, yellow down. Nice.
Aisha Khan: Ok schedule prod backfill at 8pm PT with the noted throttle. Sam, confirm when you kick it off.
Sam Ortega: Will kick at 20:00 PT. I'll ping here when it's done.
Nina (CS Ops): I'll update the CSM FAQ with a note about the playbook trigger semantics change.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team — this is a good reminder to have scoring changes locked into playbook PRs going forward.
Rory Patel: +1 on locking. Also adding a test to the CI to compare healthscore rollups after any trigger changes.
playbook-bot: Prod backfill scheduled for 2026-03-15T20:00:00-07:00.
